overview.description: The T. Rowe Price U.S. High Yield ETF (THYF) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on high yield fixed income. THYF is actively managed to hold a broad portfolio of US high-yield corporate bonds of any maturity. THYF was launched on Oct 25, 2022 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
